title: All The Netherite
description: Small texture pack making netherite cooler and making more item netherite!
body:
Making netherite cooler and more epic by remaking the tools and texturing other item so they are netherite too! If you like netherite you will like this too!

This project is in working and I will take criticism (Constructive).
Go to my discord if you want to comment!
